senses.gloss:
मुह् मुह्, i. 4, Par.
 1. To be faint, to lose consciousness, Chr. 32, 24.
 2. To be disturbed (in mind), to be perplexed, Bhag. 2, 13.
 3. To fail, Hit. iii. d. 54.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. मूध.
 1. Perplexed, confused, Śiś. 9, 77. []
 2. Foolish, stupid, Nal. 6, 12; 18, 10.
 3. Deceived.
 4. Ignorant, unlearned, Pañc. 243, 18. m.
 1. A fool, Vikr. 32, 15.
 2. A sluggard.
 II. मुग्ध.
 1. Stupid, Pañc. 166, 25.
 2. Being in love, Śāk. d. 36.
 3. Innocent, d. 24.
 4. Simple.
 5. Beautiful, lovely, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 5.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. मोहय,
 1. To perplex, MBh. 1, 5457.
 2. To infatuate, Hit. i. d. 179, M.M.; Rām. 3, 55, 22; मोकित, Infatuated, Hit. i. d. 25, M.M.
 3. To stupefy, Man. 11, 96. मोहित,
 1. Puzzled, Utt. Rāmac. 36, 8.
 2. Beguiled, Nal. 8, 16.
 --With the prep. व्या वि-आ, Caus. To disturb, to perplex, Pañc. 129, 8. व्यामोहित, Infatuated, Pañc. 199, 1.
 --With उद् उद्, उन्-मुग्ध, Disturbed, Siddh. K. 1, 1, 28.
 --With परि परि, Caus., Ātm. To perplex, MBh. 1, 3571. परिमूढ, Bewildered, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 7.
 --With प्र प्र,
 I. प्रमूढ.
 1. Fainted, Utt. Rāmac. 160, 10.
 2. Disturbed, perplexed, Matsyop. 54.
 3. Foolish, stupid, a fool.
 II. प्रमुअध. Fainted, Utt. Rāmac. 164, 17.
 --Caus. To pérturb, Draup. 6, 21. प्रमोहित, Insensible.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To be disturbed, Bhag. 2, 72.
 --Caus. To perplex, MBh. 1, 5978.
 --With वि वि,
 I. विमूढ.
 1. Bewildered, Utt. Rāmac. 101, 1.
 2. Beguiled.
 3. Foolish. m. A kind of divine being (i. e. मूध with वि, Wise), Sund. 3, 5.
 II. विमुग्ध, Bewildered, Hit. 91, 9, M.M.; [] absorbed.
 --Caus.
 1. To disturb, Bhag. 3, 40.
 2. To infatuate, Rājat. 5, 378. विमोहित, Bewitched, Kathās. 25, 274.
 --With सम् सम्, To be disturbed, MBh. 3, 10978.
 I. संमूढ.
 1. Bewildered.
 2. Stupefied.
 3. Foolish, Hit. iv. d. 71.
 4. Produced rapidly.
 5. Heaped.
 6. Broken.
 II. संमुग्ध.
 1. Fascinated.
 2. Stupefied, Utt. Rāmac. 171, 5.
 3. Beautiful.
 --Caus.
 1. To perplex, MBh. 2, 1949.
 2. To infatuate, Pañc. i. d. 210.

मुहिर मुह् + इर,
 I. adj. Foolish.
 II. m. Love, the god of love.

मुहुर् मुहुर्, probably मुह् + उ + त्रा, adv.
 1. A moment, Rām. 3, 50, 10 (cf. मुहूर्त and Rām. 3, 50, 6).
 2. Repeatedly, Vikr. d. 6. Doubled, मुहुर्-मुहुर्, adv. Repeatedly, Ṛt. 6, 9.

मुहूर्त मुहूर्त, i. e. मुहुर् + त,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A moment, Rām. 3, 50, 6; some time, Vikr. 40, 4 (परं मुहूर्तात्, After some time, not yet).
 2. The thirtieth part of a day and night, or forty-eight minutes.
 II. m. An astrologer.
 --Comp.
मुहेर मुह् + एर, m. A fool.
